video_title: The NBA Has a Major INJURY PROBLEM

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on the shift from power training to tendon work
quotes.excerpt: Instead of weightlifting and doing a lot of the power stuff that we did, a lot of players are doing more tendon work.
quotes.quote: They push this narrative of longevity of a career and being able to take care of your body, not put as much pressure on your limbs if your usage rate is up, and blah, blah, blah. I get that. Instead of weightlifting and doing a lot of the power stuff that we did, a lot of players are doing more tendon work and lower weight, higher reps. I think that the training and the intensity with what we have to do, the handling bumps, a lot of these injuries are soft tissue.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on the importance of mental preparation during training camp
quotes.excerpt: Training camp used to be the kick it. Training camp used to be you had to get your mind right.
quotes.quote: Training camp used to be the kick it. Training camp used to be you had to get your mind right for training camp. I had to get my mind right for training camp. Two-a-days, back hurt, legs hurt. I don't really want to do nothing but talk film. No girls at the hotel. We locked in, hurt, tired, exhausted, depleted.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on the need for more intensive training for NBA players
quotes.excerpt: I think they need to get back to that, man. I think we've moved to this place of we cool with just being in shape to score 30 our way.
quotes.quote: I think they need to get back to that, man. I think we've moved to this place of we cool with just being in shape to score 30 our way. And I think it just needs to be a more intensified thing. As I look back on it and think about it, when you think of the guys that played USA and played it for years, look at LeBron. Never really took a time off. Never really has been out of shape unless dealing with an injury. I think preparing your body and keeping your body at the top level, it has to be a bigger part of this.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert and Arhii Shumpert on the intensity of modern NBA players
quotes.excerpt: He was like when players come out of training camp at this point in time, he was like everybody's really going at 100%.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: That was Gilbert. Gilbert Arenas was talking about that, how he was like when players come out of training camp at this point in time, he was like everybody's really going at 100%.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: And he was like especially now because you got so many not like super teams, but he was like there's a lot of players that you're amped up to see or there's a lot of matchups that you really want to see.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: Oh no, it ain't no, you was right, it ain't no off nights in the NBA right now.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: That's yes, he was just like everybody, yes, he was like everybody, not only is the competitiveness up, but he was just like everybody does have something to prove at this point outside of just being in shape and just being a good teammate and it fits now the new look. He was like everybody's trying to prove something.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert and Arhii Shumpert on the 82-game NBA season
quotes.excerpt: It's 82 games. You can simulate it on NBA 2K. There's 82 games in the season.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: It's 82 games. You can simulate it on NBA 2K. There's 82 games in the season. If y'all want the WNBA, take your ass over there to the WNBA. They don't play 82. We play 82. Lift your weights, take your meds, and win your fucking games.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: Real talk though, I don't want to hear that. Like Mike played 82, Carl Malone played 82, John Stockton played 82, Gary Payton played 82, Carmelo Anthony, LeBron James. Now we going to play 65?

quotes.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Arhii Shumpert and Iman Shumpert on the changing level of NBA play
quotes.excerpt: The only thing is though is that the level of play I do think is different.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: The only thing is though is that the level of play I do think is different, whether it's more, whether it's less.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: There is, but I'm just saying maybe we need to take the level down then. Take the level down then. Stop doing all the fucking step backs. Take a one dribble fucking pull up.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: It's too late. That's too bad. Stop shooting it from half court. Play the game how we used to play in the post. Make it physical.
